title: Abstract Algebra II of Spring 2026
description: I intend to record my lectures from Math 422 of Spring 2026. This course should cover some intermediate group theory including group actions and Sylow theorems ( without proof ), then the basic theory of rings and ideals, next field extensions and elementary aspects of Galois theory, then Modules and select applications. I am loosely covering parts of Dummit and Foote, 3rd edition, but I also am looking at a few other books such as Rotman's Advanced Modern Algebra, 2nd Edition as well as Nicholson's Abstract Algebra ( I happen to have the 3rd edition since my 4th is currently lost ). I will post pdfs which somewhat frame these lectures at http://www.supermath.info/AbstractAlgebraII.html
